quarterly_data.quarter: Pfizer press release: Pfizer's TUKYSA Regimen Receives FDA Approval as Front-Line (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA approved TUKYSA (tucatinib) with trastuzumab and pertuzumab as maintenance treatment of HER2+ unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer after induction, expanding TUKYSA to the front-line setting as a chemotherapy-free maintenance option. In the Phase 3 HER2CLIMB-05 trial (n=326 vs 328) it cut the risk of progression or death by 35.9% (HR 0.64; p<0.0001), with median investigator-assessed PFS of 24.9 versus 16.3 months; hepatotoxicity severity was increased.
